### A Guilty Conscience
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-guilty-conscience
Passage: Jeremiah 3:3
Points:
- Jeremiah confronts Judah with shocking imagery, describing her shameless idolatry as the brazen look of a prostitute.
- Persistently ignoring God's truth and warnings leads to a seared conscience that no longer feels conviction over evil.
- Subjective feelings of guilt do not always match objective moral reality before the Lord.
- Believers must continually shape and recalibrate their consciences through the Word of God to remain sensitive to sin.
